query:
SELECT tag.tag, COUNT(*) AS "count: u32"
               FROM tag
               LEFT JOIN publication ON publication.id = tag.publication_id
               LEFT JOIN work ON work.id = tag.work_id
               WHERE tag.library_id = ?
                 AND (? OR COALESCE(publication.draft, work.draft) = 0)
               GROUP BY tag.tag
               ORDER BY tag.tag
